status: transcribed and verified hex-by-hex against images/Map7.png (VASSAL art) on 2026-10-17
method: module terrainMaps/Board 7.txt converted to hex labels (pass 1), then every hex checked against the art (pass 2) on 3-column overlay sheets annotated with the draft codes, zoomed crops (crop_hex.py), and a pixel check of woods/open share per hex and around every centre dot; trails and the railway traced as hexside crossings and map-edge exits; elevation checked with hex_colors.py and visually; objective circles confirmed against maps.json printed_objectives. Map 7 has no hexside features (none in the art, none in the module file).
classification_rule_used: terrain under the hex centre dot (Map 1 pilot rule); roads/trails/railways are features, not terrain. Trail lanes (open strips with a dashed line through the woods) are treated as part of the woods, as in the module file ("Wood trail") and the Map 1 pilot; every hex whose centre dot lies on a trail lane is flagged confidence=medium. The railway runs on an open corridor and is recorded as Open + Railway.
effort: ~45 minutes (forest map: trail lanes and woods edges)
